stage_name: Freeze and diagnose the existing baseline

privacy.sanitized_connected_context_note: Calendar comparison and broad contact outcomes are tracked; raw messages/events are not.

blockers.summary: Seven documented CLI commands only record a phase name and perform no audit work.
blockers.affected_records: universe; screen; research-fit; verify; score; report; run
blockers.proposed_repair: Wire each command to a real stage boundary with explicit inputs, outputs, failures, and row counts.

blockers.summary: run --resume ignores checkpoints and merely registers the run phase.
blockers.proposed_repair: Validate checkpoint manifests and continue from the last valid completed stage.

blockers.summary: The shared schema lacks the required Pass 2 evidence, confidence, depth, funding-gate, regional-model, rationale, and conflict fields.
blockers.proposed_repair: Version the schema and add the eight required contract areas before migrating data.
blockers.acceptance_impact: Blocks evidence-backed scoring and later stage manifests.

blockers.summary: Institution/program score components are hard-coded rather than calculated from claim-level evidence.
blockers.affected_records: US, Canada, and Europe deep-program score maps plus score corrections
blockers.proposed_repair: Replace constants with anchored component calculations carrying evidence IDs, confidence, reviewer, and verification status.
blockers.acceptance_impact: All current numeric rankings are non-auditable.

blockers.summary: Every scored program receives more than five faculty-depth points despite only one distinct professor row.
blockers.proposed_repair: Evaluate at least five plausible faculty where available, retain genuine matches, deduplicate people, and cap one-match depth at five.
blockers.acceptance_impact: Inflates department depth and total scores.

blockers.summary: The funding hard gate can pass from a retained label, funding score, and any verification text.
blockers.proposed_repair: Read funding eligibility, coverage, duration, conditions, and source IDs directly; never use recommendation or score as gate evidence.
blockers.acceptance_impact: Can turn unsupported funding into an apply recommendation.

unresolved_coverage: European ROR/API coverage is 3,628 of 4,462 reported filtered records (81.31%); 834 records remain unexposed.
EHESO/ETER returned HTTP 401 and multiple European national-registry pages were blocked.
Canada retains 50 unresolved indexed institutions and nine blocked/insufficient official program pages.
The prior mechanical screens are not an exhaustive official-program catalogue crawl.
Fall 2027 pages, funding awards, and employment vacancies that are not published remain unresolved.

next_stage.recommendation: Begin only after explicit user approval.
